language.label: UI Language
mode.cfg_description: Bind a key in autoexec to imlag_say.cfg; CS2 itself execs the dispatch. Safe & reversible.
mode.chat_description: Synthesise keystrokes to open chat, paste & send. Needs CS2 in foreground; no cfg writes.
general.title: General
general.hint: These settings apply to both modes. The watched-player list lives below.
general.only_self_death: Only fire when a watched player dies
general.player_list_empty: No watched players yet — add one above.
general.input_mode_hint: Pick how messages are delivered to CS2 on death
cfg.title: CFG Mode
cfg.hint: A single imlag_say.cfg slot is bound in autoexec. The slot is empty by default — pressing the trigger key by accident is a no-op. ImLag rewrites the slot only on a death event.
cfg.inactive_notice: CFG mode is not active. Switch from General → Input mode.
cfg.trigger_hint: Default: ins. Single letter/digit (k, 7) or a named key (ins, home, end, pgup, pgdn, del, f1–f24). The cfg is empty between deaths so a stray press does nothing.
cfg.mode.team_description: Always use team chat (say_team) — visible to your team only.
cfg.mode.random_description: Coin-flip global vs. team on every death.
chat.title: Auto-input Mode
chat.hint: Auto-input releases every held key, opens the chat box, pastes the message and sends.
chat.inactive_notice: Auto-input mode is not active. Switch from General → Input mode.
corpus.url_placeholder: Paste a plaintext or JSON URL
cfg.status.path_not_found: CS2 path not found — set it manually.
cfg.error.empty_messages: Phrase list is empty — add one first.
cfg.error.invalid_cs2_path: CS2 path is missing or invalid
cfg.error.invalid_cfg_dir: CFG folder is missing and cannot be created
